text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Retail group Jeronimo Martins forecasts consolidated sales of 430 billion escudos by the end of this year, helped by its investments in Poland, a fast-growing market, says company director Ponce Leao.
- State Brazilian telecommunications company Telebras may buy 2.5 percent of the capital of Portugal Telecom in PT's planned third stage privatisation in November.

- Only 50 percent of Portuguese children aged between three and five receive pre-school teaching, compared with the European Union average of 75 percent, according to a study by the European Commission.
- Portugal Telecom will invest 150 billion escudos in the next three years under a joint venture with Telebras.
- The Ministry of Public Works has decided to give the concession to the IP5 road to the private sector for up to 30 years.
- Economy minister Augusto Mateus meets with EU competition commissioner Karel van Miert in Brussels today to discuss a plan to restructure ship repairer Lisnave.
